briefdescription.para: Refactored Schur (symmetric-function) ring whose elements are schur_poly sums of partitions over a configurable coefficient ring.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces the older SchurRing (in schur.hpp) with a leaner implementation: partitions are stored in schur_partition sorted form rather than exponent vectors, and nvars caps the partition length (-1 means no cap, i.e. infinitely many Schur generators). Multiplication uses the Littlewood-Richardson rule via truncate. Forms the base class for SchurSnRing.
